summary: Practise hazard logging, toolbox talks and corrective-action tracking in safety steward training. Review the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Safety steward work involves observing work areas, recording hazards and routing safety concerns for follow-up. This course is for frontline stewards, HSE coordinators and supervisors, and builds practical skills in prioritizing observations, checking controls against job safety analysis and the hierarchy of controls, and tracking corrective actions, including overdue items, within existing safety-management arrangements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who observe workplace conditions, relay safety concerns or coordinate follow-up actions within operational teams.
modules: Hierarchy of Controls in Field Checks
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
